scope: AI-generated editorial concept illustrations for the haptics development journal; not screenshots, device endorsements, or measured waveforms.

images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide editorial illustration for a Chinese game-streaming development journal. Primary request: illustrate the freedom of playing a PC game away from the desk using different handheld setups. A cohesive panoramic composition with three softly blended vignettes: relaxing on a sofa playing on a smartphone with subtle on-screen touch buttons; traveling light with a phone held in a compact telescopic game controller near a small day bag; a tablet on a living-room side table with a separate white-and-black game controller beside it. Screens show the same original stylized mountain exploration game, no existing game characters or logos. Small restrained tactile ripples near the hands suggest feedback. Style: refined hand-painted editorial illustration, soft grain, calm contemporary technology magazine, warm natural lighting, muted cream, dusty teal and sage with warm amber accents. Human hands anatomically natural. Landscape aspect ratio around 2:1, generous breathing room, clear large silhouettes, coherent scene rather than boxed panels. No words, letters, logos, branding, watermarks, UI labels, or exaggerated neon. This is a conceptual illustration, not a product screenshot.

reference.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: second wide editorial conceptual illustration within a Chinese game-streaming haptics journal, about rhythm, subtle strength and silence. A close intimate view of two natural human hands holding a smartphone horizontally, playing an original mountain climbing adventure. The tiny unbranded explorer on screen is reaching toward a rocky ledge. Below and around the device, tasteful painterly marks express touch: several small distinct amber brush dashes with generous unpainted gaps, one slightly stronger rounded stroke and a soft fading teal stroke. These marks are a poetic visual metaphor for short pulses, varied intensity and quiet intervals, NOT a technical waveform or measurement. Include a simple unobtrusive gamepad resting near the phone to suggest companion devices, with no brands. Style: refined hand-painted magazine editorial illustration with delicate pencil contours and subtle paper texture, warm cream background, muted sage and dusty teal, restrained amber highlights. Landscape 2:1, sparse balanced composition, clear negative space, soft natural light. No words, letters, labels, arrows, charts, neon, brand logos, watermarks or fake app UI. Anatomically credible hands. This image should support thoughtful design prose rather than look like an advertising poster.
